name: Kujou Amane
source: A second-year and Student Council President at Izumigamori Academy. She's also one of [url=/c83565]Tomoyuki's[/url] childhood friend, and often teased as "a male friend" by him. She is diligent and serious when it comes to her duty. Despite that, she is quite honest and want to make school a fun place to be, making her popular among the students beside her cuteness.
